Blocks.Text: The Organization Authorizations DMA API allow you to access an organization's administrative data on its behalf.
The API provides the following method:

Get authorization for an action to be made on behalf of an organization.
Batch get authorizations for actions to be made on behalf of organizations.
Find all the organizations that a particular impersonator has for particular authorizations to do on behalf of that organization.

Rows.Text: Retrieve your organization’s posts, comments, reactions, and other engagement data. Retrieve your organization’s pages and their reporting data (including follower, visitor and content analytics).

Rows.Text: Represents the subject that is attempting to perform the desired action on the organization.
The scope within which the subject can attempt to perform an action on the organization.

Represents the subject that can attempt to perform an action on a target. It can be of type urn:li:person:{ID},urn:li:enterpriseProfile:(urn:li:enterpriseAccount:{ID_1},{ID_2}) (see below table for more details on EnterpriseProfileUrn) or EnterpriseMember.

A reference to the enterprise user. It is of type urn:li:enterpriseProfile:(urn:li:enterpriseAccount:{ID_1},{ID_2}). Where ID_1 is the ID of the enterprise account which this user belongs to. ID_2 is the unique ID of this user profile within the enterprise account, there is no guarantee that this ID would be unique globally.
A reference to the member. It is of type urn:li:person:{ID}.
Represents the scope within which a subject can attempt to perform an action on a target.

The Business Manager account. This will be specified when the target for the Decision falls within a Business Manager account. For example, SponsoredAccount/Organization. It is of type urn:li:businessManagerAccount:{ID}. The ID of the business manager account entity.

The asset urn to optionally be added to the scope. This will be specified when the target for the Decision falls within the scope of a Business Manager account and an asset. It is of type urn:li:organizatio:{ID}.

Represents the enterprise platform scope within which a subject can attempt to perform an action on a target. It is of type urn:li:enterpriseApplicationInstance:(urn:li:enterpriseAccount:{ID_1},{ID_2}). Where ID_1 is the ID of the enterprise account which this Application Instance belongs to and ID_2 is the unique ID of this Application Instance within the enterprise account, there is no guarantee that this ID would be unique globally.

A type of action a user can take on an organization on behalf of a Business Manager. Value enums include:ORGANIZATION_CLAIM (Action denoting a user wants to claim an organization on behalf of a Business Manager)
Values: ORGANIZATION_CLAIM (Action denoting a user wants to claim an organization on behalf of a Business Manager)

Rows.Text: An action that a user can take on an organization's broadcasts. A broadcast is an organization curated piece of content that is distributed to employees of the organization with the goal of encouraging employees to share the content to their LinkedIn network. Value enum includes:BROADCAST_CREATE (Action denoting that a user wants to create a broadcast for an organization)BROADCAST_EDIT (Action denoting that a user wants to edit a specific broadcast for an organization)BROADCAST_DELETE (Action denoting that a user wants to delete a specific broadcast for an organization)BROADCAST_READ (Action denoting that a user wants to view any broadcast for an organization)BROADCAST_ANALYTICS_READ (Action denoting that a user wants to view broadcast analytics)
Values: BROADCAST_CREATE (Action denoting that a user wants to create a broadcast for an organization)
BROADCAST_EDIT (Action denoting that a user wants to edit a specific broadcast for an organization)
BROADCAST_DELETE (Action denoting that a user wants to delete a specific broadcast for an organization)
BROADCAST_READ (Action denoting that a user wants to view any broadcast for an organization)

Rows.Text: The UGC(User Generated Content) URN of the broadcast this action is being taken on. If empty, this authorization action represents an attempt create or read broadcasts. For edits and deletes on broadcasts this field is required, and the authorization action represents an attempt to edit or delete a particular broadcast. This field can be either of type ShareUrn (urn:li:share:{SHARE_ID}) or UgcPostUrn (urn:li:ugcPost:{POST_ID}).

Blocks.Text:
How to determine the parameters for GET and BATCH_GET:
The GET and BATCH_GET methods below require you to already know the organization URN, the action, and your own personUrn (used in impersonation.subject.value.member) in order to construct the ORGANIZATION_AUTHORIZATION_KEY.

To determine your own personUrn for impersonation.subject.value.member, call the Me resource and construct the URN as urn:li:person:{id} using the returned id field.
To discover which organizations and actions you are eligible for, use BATCH_FIND by authorizationAction and Authenticated Member below, which does not require you to already know an organization URN.

curl --location 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/dmaOrganizationAuthorizations/($params:(),{ORGANIZATION_AUTHORIZATION_KEY})' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}' \
--header 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \
--header 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'
